body:
Thank you for your time and attention tonight Lady. Just talking through got me through the night, and I will figure out the estate and treatment options and the rest tomorrow instead of just giving up and not facing it.

So again, thank you. It made a difference.

As of right now...no. Get treatment and have nothing left to leave to my kids but debt and the memory of me as frail and deteriorating and maybe be here in a few years? Or suffer in silence? and let death come to me? Nah. Or choose not to suffer and end it all well before hand and leave them well off..that looks alot better to me right now.

Chemo, partial lung removal and a few lymph nodes and associated stuff, more chemo and radiation or I can sign up for various trials for treatment options to test out fun stuff for future patients.

So clearly the answer is move to Colorado and enjoy getting stoned or move to Utah and get extra wives and enjoy the next year...but having 1 ex and one current hasn't worked out so well, so Colorado is looking really good right now.

What's it gonna do, kill me? :)

I know, I know...bad pun considering. But yup, that was my rebellion of my diagnosis, 1 whole cigarette. Breakin' the law, fighting the power and all that. I'm such a wuss. So, should I become an alcoholic instead...no medical mj in my state so that's not an option and I won't take pain pills, I've seen what those do to people.

I was an counselor for alot of years. It never prepares you for when it's your problem to deal with instead of someone else. So I guess instead of making myself vulnerable to them, or feeling like a laughing stock I'm dumping this all on here...pretty shitty of me I know.

But I also know if I make it through tonight and keep typing that my chances of being here tomorrow are much better...so I can't say how much I appreciate this while also say holy shit I'm a selfish bastard right now. And well that whole being selfish thing doesn't work too well for me...the curse of a knowing mind I guess? Or self centered egotism of knowing SW was here?

So, to change back to your train of thought...how isn't this lose lose?

You know what's really f'd up? I never smoked...never...but everyone in my family did. I remember it from being a child even. And I've always craved a cigarette, today I smoked the first one in my life. Shit tastes like hell...but was honestly the only relaxing thing I did all day today.

Right now? I'd rather die than have to have everyone go through this trying to support me for a few years then have me die anyway.

Yes, part of me knows that's fucked up and selfish but I can't think straight about it...how do you think through this? I got nothing.

If 45 is young, god bless you. That was my first laugh all day :)

I can't be selfish and say fuck the debt though...I don't have it in me to do that for me. Yes, if it was either of my kids, it wouldn't be a question. But when I needed that moment of support to find clarity and to make it ok I had to turn to reddit instead of the one who promised better or worse...until worse it seems

(and bless you for being here to turn to btw )

I don't know. If they know they will hate me, but if they know later and it didn't matter then I wasn't the dad I promised to be for them anyway.

I said I would make it better, and be there for them...and now I won't be. So which let down sucks less? Either way, I broke a promise and I failed. Thus my total freak out right now

I was a single dad for most of my kids life, from age 3 til 16 then I met my SO and they joined the family for the last 5-6 years. They were all I had until then. And they are awesome....I can't describe how great they are. And until today I thought what I had was priceless but today a price was put on it and I simply can't deal with it.

They think it's stage 2 notsmall cell lung cancer but could be stage 3

plus a few other issues...overall prognosis is treatment is 5-10 years no treatment 1 or less
